items.title: UN warns of 'supersized' El Niño as countries prepare for impact
items.description: The WMO has warned that the natural weather phenomenon could bring disruption to global economies.

items.title: Toxic wildfire haze spreads across South East Asia as 'super' El Niño intensifies
items.description: Millions of people have been exposed to the smog, with more than 12,000 children suffering respiratory issues.

items.title: Feminist activist and journalist Gloria Steinem dies, aged 92
items.description: Her foundation said she "passed away peacefully" at her home in New York City, "surrounded by many who loved her".

items.title: Channel smuggling gangs resort to 'mega-dinghies' as crackdown limits small boat supply
items.description: Once-rival criminal groups are being forced to work together because of a shortage of small boats, a BBC investigation has found.

items.title: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say
items.description: Al-Mughayyir's council says they were trying to stop settlers stealing sheep, but the Israeli military says they threw stones at its troops.

items.title: Anthony Joshua's driver attempted overtake before fatal crash, trial hears
items.description: Adeniyi Mobolaji Kayode is charged in Nigeria with offences including causing death by dangerous driving.

items.title: Trump $1 coin makes him first living president on US currency in a century
items.description: The US Mint special edition is stamped with a portrait of Trump alongside the words "LIBERTY" and "IN GOD WE TRUST"

items.title: More than 80 migrants feared dead after boat rescued off Canary Islands
items.description: Rescuers found 44 survivors on board the vessel but bad weather meant they had to leave five bodies behind.

items.title: Vance's Antichrist comments are a 'common belief', his friend tells BBC
items.description: The US vice-president recently mused with a Christian podcast host on whether the end of the world was nigh.

items.title: Liechtenstein MPs vote to legalise abortion despite threat of veto
items.description: Organisers of the citizens' initiative say they have popular support, even though the all-powerful monarch has said he will veto the legislation.

items.title: Kenyan president orders crackdown on foreigners operating small businesses
items.description: It comes amid concerns over the growing number of traders from neighbouring countries.

items.title: 'Beautiful, vibrant' Disney star Carla Jeffery dies aged 33
items.description: Jeffery was known for playing cheerleader Bree in 2018 Disney Channel movie Zombies and two sequels.

items.title: Embattled Spanish PM insists there were no prior warnings before Ceuta crisis
items.description: Pedro Sánchez tells parliament it is absurd to think the government knew and did nothing, after thousands join protests in Spanish cities.

items.title: Sydney police investigate second possible mistaken identity killing in two days
items.description: Wednesday's fatal shooting of a man in his 40s comes after a university student was gunned down on Tuesday.

items.title: Rocky Horror star Tim Curry's cause of death revealed as coronary artery disease
items.description: The British actor had significant conditions, cited on his death certificate in Los Angeles County.

items.title: Maltese tycoon acquitted of orchestrating murder of renowned journalist
items.description: Daphne Caruana Galizia exposed corruption and money laundering schemes in Malta before she was killed by a car bomb in 2017.

items.title: EU and Nato vow to step up pressure on Russia after 'new escalation' in Germany
items.description: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.

items.title: Who is Alejandro Betancourt, colourful oil baron behind US-Venezuela oil deal?
items.description: The 46-year-old figure of international intrigue has an apparent knack for being in the right place at the right time.

items.title: LA Clippers fined $30m over Leonard pay scandal
items.description: The LA Clippers are fined $30m by the NBA for violating salary rules in order to funnel millions of dollars to star player Kawhi Leonard.

items.title: How Gloria Steinem changed the lives of generations of women
items.description: The trailblazing feminist spoke out for the legalisation of abortion, same-sex marriage and equal pay for women - but her activism was not without backlash.
